lines.zh: 叶脉像小路，我走得很慢。
lines.en: Leaf veins are roads; I walk them slowly.
My body arches and stretches forward
The leaf sways, and the wind is to blame
I grip the leaf edge with tiny feet

lines.zh: 这一片叶子我走了三天
lines.en: I have walked this leaf for three days

lines.zh: 我爬过叶子上的一道折痕
lines.en: I crawl over a crease in the leaf
Every inch takes a long time

lines.zh: 我身后留下一条极细的痕
lines.en: A very fine trail follows me

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉慢慢爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl slowly along the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我停下,量了量下一片叶
lines.en: I pause and measure the next leaf

lines.zh: 叶子边缘有虫咬过的洞
lines.en: The leaf edge has holes bitten through
I go slowly around a dewdrop
A little further, then I rest
I press flat to the leaf, almost see-through
I move from this leaf to that one
My body grows more sluggish
I rest in the middle of a vein

lines.zh: 一动不动，像一小截枝条
lines.en: Still as a little twig

lines.zh: 我只吃叶子，别的都不碰
lines.en: I eat only leaves, nothing else
My colors are paler than summer's
I raise my front half and hold it there
The spots of light on the leaf are the sun
I tuck my feet beneath my body
I can still eat a while longer

lines.zh: 我不打算离开这片叶子
lines.en: I do not plan to leave this leaf
A stronger gust and I curl up
I know I am close to changing
The veins look like a map
You are blocking my leaf
I lift my head, only a little
That looks like a leaf in your hand

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我见过手
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know hands
Do not pinch me, I am soft

lines.zh: 你可以把我挪到别的叶上
lines.en: You may move me to another leaf

lines.zh: 我停在这里是有理由的
lines.en: I have my reasons for staying here
You have watched me a long while
There are fine hairs on me

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就缩成一团
lines.en: Come closer and I curl into a ball

lines.zh: 我把身子蜷成叶上的结。
lines.en: I curl into a knot on the leaf.
A few hairs came off
That squashed me flat

lines.zh: 我把压扁的身子一节节撑开。
lines.en: I stretch my flattened body out segment by segment.
My fluid is on the leaf
It hurts too much to move
My feet will not quite obey
I am still hanging on the leaf edge

lines.zh: 这一下要用三天才长回来
lines.en: That will take three days to mend
I am soft, I cannot take impacts
It is a leaf, I can smell it

lines.zh: 放近一点，我自己爬过去
lines.en: Set it closer, I will crawl over
This leaf has a tender edge
I am only interested in this one
Do not move your hand, I have not reached it
Bite in and the sap comes out
I eat slowly, do not rush me

lines.zh: 叶子换一片也还是叶子
lines.en: Another leaf is still a leaf
I nibble around the leaf's rim
This is better than the last one
You touched my body

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，脚全收起来
lines.en: I flinch and pull all my feet in
The leaf rocked with it
I am light, I cannot crush you
Do not let me fall
On that bump I gripped the leaf edge
We are crowded on the same leaf

lines.zh: 往旁边挪一点，让开叶脉。
lines.en: Shifting aside to clear the leaf vein.
You wrinkled my leaf
Fall and I cannot find my way back
In this shape, it is hardly a matter

lines.zh: 我闻到叶子上有同类的味道
lines.en: I smell another of my kind on the leaf

lines.zh: 两只挤在一片叶上太窄
lines.en: Two on one leaf would be cramped
Wait until we both have wings

lines.zh: 同类之间也只是各吃各的
lines.en: Kin like us just eat apart

lines.zh: 我在这片叶子等过一只
lines.en: I have waited for one on this leaf
It crawled slowly, just like me
We edge toward the leaf tip together
Neither of us hurries the other
Perhaps we meet again later
You are holding me up
My feet left the leaf, I dislike it
I curl into a ring

lines.zh: 叶子的味道还在你手上
lines.en: The leaf's smell is still on your hand
Just put me back on a leaf
Away from leaves I do not last long
I cling to your finger
This is much slicker than a leaf
Your palm is warm

lines.zh: 再放低一点，我够到叶了
lines.en: Lower me a bit, I can reach the leaf
I smell a tender leaf ahead.
I head that way

lines.zh: 叶子的边缘起了一点黄
lines.en: The leaf's edge has started to yellow
This spot does not taste right
I need to change leaves
That stem is close to me
I must find a place to put my feet
This vein leads that way
I dislike being moved about
I have chosen this one
I crawl over an inch at a time
Half a finger's width to go
There is wind over there, it will sway
I wait for the leaf to settle
My feet need a solid grip
There is no gap on this route

lines.zh: 那片叶的影子落在我身上
lines.en: That leaf's shadow falls on me
Slow going, but I haven't stopped.
This leaf will last two more days
Once there, I will be at ease
I shove at you in little humps.
I gnaw at your finger.
My bristles are a little prickly.
I lay my body across to block
All I can do is chew leaves
This bite works on leaves
I cannot push you
I puff up to look bigger
Do not take that seriously
I will go back to eating leaves
I have come out of the egg
My first bite was this leaf
I settled on the underside of a leaf
Everything around is green
I found a vein first
I crawl slowly, afraid of falling
The leaf is much bigger than I am
I am still a little damp
I paused before daring to move
There is enough here for a long time

lines.zh: 叶子先烧起来，我跟着烫
lines.en: The leaf caught first, then I burned
The leaf sways and I fall.
Water plasters me to the leaf
The blast blew me off the leaf
Something flying pierced through me
That force curled me into a ball
Off the leaves, hunger makes me limp

lines.zh: 雷光里，叶子和我都在抖
lines.en: In the lightning, the leaf and I both shake
There are no leaves in the void
